evals.prompt: Add a new process to biopipen/ns/scrna.py called CellCycleScoring that runs Seurat's CellCycleScoring function. It should take the Seurat object, have envs for the S-phase gene list, the G2M-phase gene list, and the assay, run the scoring, save the scored object, and produce a report section with a table of the per-cell scores and a histogram plot of the scores split by seurat cluster.
evals.expected_output: A declarative Proc subclass named CellCycleScoring in scrna.py style (input/output/lang/envs_depth/script/plugin_opts, docstring with Input/Output/Envs/Requires sections), plus an R script template at biopipen/scripts/scrna/CellCycleScoring.R using get_logger/get_reporter, do_call for CellCycleScoring, save_plot for the histogram, write_table for the scores, and reporter$add2 for the report section.
expectations: Declarative class: input/output/lang/script attributes, no run()
Dotted R args (s.features/g2m.features) become kebab-case env keys
R script uses biopipen.utils, get_logger(), get_reporter()
Dashed env keys referenced via envs["..."] subscript, not dot notation

evals.prompt: I need a HarmonyIntegration process for scrna.py that wraps Seurat's RunHarmony. The envs should include group.by.vars (the R arg with a dot in it), reduction, dims, and ncores. It should also support optional per-group diagnostic plots (a UMAP colored by each group.by.vars value) with per-case devpars settings. Follow the biopipen env naming conventions exactly.
evals.expected_output: A declarative Proc subclass HarmonyIntegration with env keys following biopipen naming rules (group-by-vars kebab-cased for the dotted R arg), envs_depth=4 for nested per-case plot configs, an R script with do_call to RunHarmony, extract_vars stripping control vars before calls, per-case tryCatch sections, and auto_devpars-driven plot sizing.
expectations: Declarative class: input/output/lang/script attributes, no run()
envs_depth = 4 for nested per-case plot configs
Dotted R arg group.by.vars becomes kebab-case env key group-by-vars
Docstring documents the R name group.by.vars
Control vars (devpars/more_formats) stripped before tool calls
Per-group diagnostic plots wrapped in tryCatch -> log$warn
Per-case devpars handled (auto_devpars or defaults merge)

evals.prompt: Write a GSEAEnrichment process for biopipen that runs clusterProfiler enrichment with multiple optional databases (each configured as its own case with dbs, plots and tables), plus a test class in tests/test_scrna/GSEAEnrichment/test.py following the LOCAL_ONLY local-test conventions with testing() assertions on the output tables and plots.
evals.expected_output: A declarative Proc subclass with an enrich-style env structure (per-case dicts deep-merged via envs_depth), an R script with tryCatch-wrapped optional per-database sections that strip control vars (extract_vars) before clusterProfiler calls, reporter$add2 sections with descr+plot+table items, and a local-only test class file with run.env containing LOCAL_ONLY="true".
expectations: Declarative class: input/output/lang/script attributes, no run()
envs_depth = 4 so per-case dicts deep-merge across subclasses
Optional per-database sections wrapped in tryCatch -> log$warn
Control vars stripped with extract_vars before clusterProfiler calls
Test file defines test classes subclassing the process
Test asserts via testing(pipen) with pipen.run()
